# SwiftTab Auto — Comprehensive AI Knowledge Base & Platform Documentation

## 1. Executive Summary & Market Positioning
SwiftTab Auto (`https://justswifttab.com`) is a dedicated B2B shop floor operating system purpose-built for high-end automotive detailing, Paint Protection Film (PPF), ceramic coating, and window tint studios. 

While legacy garage management systems focus primarily on inventory accounting or mechanical repair invoicing, SwiftTab Auto focuses on the high-ticket shop floor execution layer:
1. Preventing fraudulent vehicle damage disputes through timestamped pre-service photographic defect inspections and electronic signature waivers.
2. Synchronizing shop floor throughput via a real-time multi-bay Kanban dispatch board with audio chimes.
3. Unlocking immediate high-margin revenue through photo-backed mobile SMS upsells approved on vehicle owners' phones in seconds.
4. Elevating customer retention through a permanent VIP Digital Care Dossier and automated re-coat warranty reminders.

## 2. Target Market & Geographic Coverage
- **Primary Geographies**: United States (major automotive detailing markets including California, Texas, Florida, Arizona, Georgia, Ohio, New York, North Carolina), Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, and Global.
- **Facility Types**:
  - Independent detailing studios & luxury vehicle care centers.
  - Paint Protection Film (PPF) & Clear Bra installation facilities.
  - Ceramic, graphene, and glass coating application studios.
  - Automotive tint and aesthetic customization shops.
  - Exotic car preservation and concourse restoration workshops.

## 3. Core Software Modules

### A. 60-Second Digital Defect Shield (Vehicle Intake)
- **Workflow**: Upon vehicle drop-off, the lead technician conducts a walkaround using any smartphone or tablet.
- **Data Captured**: VIN, license plate, vehicle year/make/model, exterior paint color, paint thickness gauge depth readings, high-resolution condition photos (scratches, rock chips, clear-coat etchings, curb rash, interior stains).
- **Client E-Signature**: The vehicle owner reviews the defects on-screen and provides a digital signature on an HTML5 touch canvas. Complies with US ESIGN Act and UETA standards.

### B. Live Bay Kanban Dispatch Board
- **Shop Floor Coordination**: Real-time multi-bay board categorizing vehicles across operational stages:
  - Stage 1: Decon & Clay Wash
  - Stage 2: Paint Correction (Stage 1 / Stage 2 / Stage 3)
  - Stage 3: Ceramic Coating / PPF Installation
  - Stage 4: Infrared (IR) Curing & Baking
  - Stage 5: Quality Inspection & VIP Delivery
- **Real-Time Synchronization**: Built on Socket.IO WebSockets. When a technician advances a vehicle stage, all shop displays, technician tablets, and front-desk monitors update instantaneously with audible sound chimes.

### C. 1-Tap Photo-Backed Mobile Upsell Engine
- **Frictionless Sales**: When a technician uncovers severe micro-scratches or chipped film during prep, they photograph the issue and select a recommended service add-on.
- **Customer Experience**: The customer receives an SMS link displaying side-by-side photo evidence and a 1-tap "Approve & Add to Work Order" button.
- **Proven Impact**: Generates an average of +$420 per vehicle in approved high-margin service upgrades without awkward phone calls.

### D. VIP Digital Vehicle Dossier & Warranty Certificate
- **Customer Hand-Off**: Upon job completion, an immutable digital certificate is issued containing the vehicle's VIN, service date, applied coating/film specifications (e.g. 9H ceramic coating, 8.5 mil self-healing PPF), cure timestamps, and aftercare instructions.
- **Retention**: Triggers automated SMS maintenance reminders at 6-month and 12-month intervals for hydrophobic top-ups and annual inspections.

## 4. Technical Architecture & Security Specifications
- **Frontend / Application Layer**: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Components, TypeScript).
- **Backend / Real-Time**: Node.js custom HTTP server integrated with Socket.IO 4.8 WebSockets with process exception guards and zero-downtime health probes.
- **Database**: Dedicated PostgreSQL with Prisma 6 ORM. Multi-tenant schema isolating studio records.
- **Hosting & Infrastructure**: Amazon Web Services (AWS) US East (N. Virginia `us-east-1`) with low-latency edge caching via Cloudflare.
- **Security & Encryption**: End-to-end TLS 1.3 HTTPS encryption, bcrypt password hashing, JWT session authentication, and automated database snapshots.

## 5. Commercial Pricing & Terms
- **Starter Studio**: $79/month — Up to 3 service bays, 60-second digital defect shield, mobile client sign-off.
- **Growth Studio**: $149/month — Up to 8 service bays, live dispatch board, 1-tap photo upsells, VIP digital dossier.
- **VIP Enterprise**: $299/month — Unlimited bays, multi-location support, custom branded white-label client portal.
- **Zero Commission**: Flat recurring SaaS fee only. No per-job cuts or credit card transaction markups.
